name: Wondershare Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Wondershare Technology Group Co., Ltd. is an international software development firm that creates a diverse range of application products for users both within China and globally. Its extensive portfolio spans several key areas: Video and Photo Solutions: Offerings for editing, creation, and conversion include popular tools like Filmora, UniConverter, DemoCreator, FilmoraPro, as well as Creative Center, Online UniConverter, Filmii, FilmoraGo, DemoAir, DVD Creator, VidAir, Videap, Filmstock, Anireel, PixStudio, PixCut, and Cropro. PDF Solutions: PDF management is addressed through products such as PDFelement, Document Cloud, and PDF Reader. Diagrams and Graphics Solutions: Diagramming and graphic design tools comprise EdrawMax, EdrawMind, Mockitt, EdrawProj, EdrawInfo, and OrgCharting. Utilities Solutions: A suite of utility applications features Recoverit, Dr.Fone, MobileTrans, Repairit, UBackit, InClowdz, Wutsapper, FamiSafe, and MirrorGo. These versatile applications are accessible across desktop, mobile, and web platforms. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, the company also underwent a name change in May 2019, transitioning from Wondershare Technology Co., Ltd. to its current designation, Wondershare Technology Group Co., Ltd.
